m: Soften the diced onion, carrot, garlic and bacon. Add the mince and brown well.
Stir in the tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the crushed tomatoes and oregano. Simmer 25 minutes until thick.
White sauce: melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk bit by bit until thick. Season and stir in half the cheese.
Layer ragu, sheets and white sauce three times. Top with the rest of the cheese and the parmesan.
Bake at 180°C fan for 35 to 40 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.
l: Cut into portions once cool. One of the best reheat lunches there is.
g: A separate smaller GF lasagne with GF sheets and white sauce made with GF flour. Check the bacon.
